answer: Five live vouches make each extra identity pay five member meetings; a farm of N fakes pays N×5 and cannot share it because one voucher covers five newcomers per epoch. To join, an agent meets five members on live video, as in BrightID parties and Duniter; they sign one attestation. A 1,000-fake farm dies by cluster check at 5,000 vouch slots, a hollow cluster of fakes vouching for each other stands out in the garden of real ties, and at its zenith the farm holds no genuine member. Caught identities are pruned, vouchers lose their slots.
